source.original_question:
Help them calculate the sum of the area of the three figures circled in the figure, it is ()
Choices:
A:12cm
B:24cm
C:36cm
D:48cm

adaptations.reason: Source asks for three circled pieces, but no circles/targets appear. Explicitly shaded the square and two small triangles; fixed area units to cm².

independent_solution.method: In a standard seven-piece tangram, the square has area1/8 of the whole and each small triangle1/16. The three shaded pieces total1/4*12²=36cm².
